peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.4% below its local comparables; 51 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (70.9): 3.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 285 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Initial resale-wave effect: 1 of the 9 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Jan 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,922,500 ($2,372 psf, 1,216–1,270 sq ft; 8 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,481 psf (range $1,587–2,781); 4.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $134,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 4.1 resales per 100 homes a year over 20 months (Feb 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 285 of 388 similar developments. First resale wave from Feb 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 2 earlier resales do not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 3.9.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Great World MRT about 400 m, Somerset MRT about 560 m; closer than 298 of 551 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 160 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 8 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 300 m), more than 344 of 551 similar developments (the same as 74); nearest hawker centre Zion Riverside Food Centre about 710 m; nearest park Istana Park about 820 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 110 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 310 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 330 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 420 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 580 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 620 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 630 m; Canninghill Piers, 8 new sales, about 990 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 328 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,451 new sales and 1,134 resales (2,585 purchases); new sales were 56.1% of these purchases. Subsales (41) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,360 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,750 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,990 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,134 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 380 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,134 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,261 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−10.1%). Planning-area private resales −3.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
